title: Creamy Chocolate Panna Cotta
description: A rich and creamy dessert made with cacao and topped with a velvety texture.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine cocoa powder and cocoa butter. Heat over low heat, stirring until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together panna cotta creamer, sugar, and heavy cream until well combined.
Add the sour cream to the panna cotta mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the chocolate mixture into the panna cotta mixture and whisk until well combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
To serve, top with yvelvety cream or whipped cream, if desired.
